originalPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / game design explanation board.
Create one polished landscape 16:9 game design storyboard image for a Markdown specification of a very simple Three.js Wii steering wheel racing prototype. This is a conceptual mockup, NOT an implemented game screenshot. All readable labels in Korean except checkpoint identifiers.
Style: clean, bright, low-poly primitive geometry, achievable student prototype graphics, soft daylight, muted green flat grass, charcoal gray road, white lane markings, orange safety cones, teal compact toy car made of simple boxes and four cylinders. No realistic cars, no other racers, no characters, no hills, no jumps, no elaborate scenery, no brands or Nintendo logos. Calm cream presentation board background with large legible typography and clear panel spacing.
Title at top exactly: "Wii 핸들 레이싱 시제품"
Subtitle exactly: "화면 예상도 · 실제 실행 화면이 아니다"
Composition: one large left panel occupying 62% width showing an in-game third-person chase camera view from behind and above one teal box car entering a broad right curve on an oval road. Show horizon, grass, white/red low edge markers, next checkpoint represented by two small yellow posts flanking road (not solid obstacle). Overlay a simple Korean HUD: "1 / 3 바퀴", "00:24.6", "속도 12", "Wii 연결". Bottom HUD steering indicator labeled "조향" and modest buttons "일시정지" and "차량 복귀". This panel header "01 · 3바퀴 타임어택".
Upper right panel header "02 · 자유 주행 연습장" showing small isometric practice yard, one teal car, straight lane and cones in a wide flat rectangular area. Label below "직진 · 회전 · 정지 연습".
Lower right panel header "03 · 코스 배치" with a precisely drawn top-down simple oval circuit and clockwise driving direction arrows. Place four clearly legible checkpoint labels at distinct points: "CP0 출발선" on bottom straight, "CP1" on left curve, "CP2" on upper straight, "CP3" on right curve. Clockwise direction around oval means car on bottom straight travels left, left curve goes upward, upper straight goes right, right curve goes down. Never use counterclockwise arrows. Top-down teal car near bottom straight points left. Caption "CP0 → CP1 → CP2 → CP3 → CP0".
Bottom narrow strip with three simple generic steering-wheel drawings with a small white rectangular motion controller in the center: tilted left, upright, tilted right. Captions "왼쪽으로 기울이면 좌회전", "가운데는 직진", "오른쪽으로 기울이면 우회전". Small note "2 버튼 가속 · 1 버튼 브레이크".
Make Korean text accurate and large; only a small controlled amount of text. Do not add features beyond this spec. The picture should clearly communicate a small approachable one-player driving prototype, not a polished commercial racing game.
